thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that running a business provides a fundamental edge over professional investors who rely on spreadsheets because entrepreneurs focus on a few key variables and understand the inherent messiness of business trajectories. He further contends that growing up in chaotic environments like India or China allows one to see order within the chaos, identifying great teams and businesses that can transcend macroeconomic issues like currency instability or political leadership.
